answer: A workable design: meter the marginal energy cost of each new identity against the network's median. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its walnut recurs, its sable survives audit, and a garden from an unlinked peer confirms it.
